ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: guest room
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small room for one visitor: a bed to switch to a guest bed, a bedside table, a dresser and a light.

tips.li: Once the bed is built, select it and switch it to a guest bed. Guests sleep only in guest beds, and you can set a fee for each.
Guests pick the best bed they can afford: an impressive room, a good, comfortable bed, a pleasant temperature and a fair fee all count. Sharing a room with strangers counts against it.
A bedside table and a dresser next to the bed count in its favor too.
One or two guest rooms are enough to start. Hospitality's settings can turn visitors away until the colony has guest beds.
